challenge.objective: Create a functional agent prototype using Boomi MCP connectors to diagnose IT incidents and propose remediations.
requirements: 1. Expose a mock IT ticket lookup process via Boomi MCP Server connector.
2. Connect an LLM agent in Boomi Agentstudio to query ticket status and error logs.
3. Implement guardrails preventing the agent from executing destructive actions without approval.
4. Log all tool invocations and token usage through AI Gateway.
challenge.expected_output: A verified, interactive agent in Agentstudio Test Panel that diagnoses mock incident tickets and outputs structured JSON remediation steps.
challenge.name: Build an MCP-Powered Incident Resolution Agent (InstaFIX Prototype)

concept_of_the_day.how_it_works: MCP acts as an open protocol standard connecting AI agents to external tools and data sources via JSON-RPC 2.0. Boomi implements MCP both as a server (exposing integration processes as tools) and as a client (agents calling enterprise tools).
concept_of_the_day.problem_solved: Eliminates fragmented, custom point-to-point tool connectors for LLMs, enabling governed enterprise tool exposure, dynamic capability discovery, and secure execution.
concept_of_the_day.connection_to_agents: Enables Boomi Agentstudio agents to discover and invoke enterprise integration processes, ERP systems, and cloud APIs seamlessly and securely.
concept_of_the_day.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) in Enterprise Integration
concept_of_the_day.real_world_application: TGH's MCP exposure layer enables enterprise clients to safely connect autonomous AI agents to legacy ERP, CRM, and database workflows.

things_to_watch.long_term: Distributed Agent Runtimes running self-hosted local models with edge governance and automated zero-shot integration refactoring.
things_to_watch.medium_term: Adoption of A2A protocol alongside MCP for multi-agent delegation; India DPDP compliance enforcement across agent data flows.
things_to_watch.short_term: GA rollout of Boomi Orchestrate and MCP Server connector; Anthropic Claude Managed Agents in Control Tower.

enterprise_connection.auditability: Boomi Agent Control Tower (ACT) and AI Gateway provide centralized session logs, token tracking, prompt injection guardrails, and enterprise kill-switches.
enterprise_connection.n8n: n8n integrates directly as an orchestration engine, AI workflow coordinator, and MCP client/server to bridge multi-agent systems and enterprise messaging.
enterprise_connection.apis_and_boomi: Boomi Connect provides 1,000+ managed MCP-enabled tools, AI Gateway for policy/token metering, and the MCP Server connector for exposing Atomsphere processes as tools.

learning_path.build_this_month: Implement multi-agent supervisor/worker patterns, Agent Control Tower governance, and DPDP compliance checklists (Phase 3 & 4).
learning_path.learn_today: Understand Git basics, REST APIs/JSON, and Boomi Atomsphere platform fundamentals (Phase 1, Weeks 1-5).
learning_path.explore_this_week: Hands-on with Boomi Agentstudio, Agent Designer, and registering integration processes via MCP Server connector (Phase 2, Weeks 6-14).

hype_vs_reality.where_it_works: Supervised agentic workflows, RAG with deterministic lookups, incident remediation (e.g., TGH-InstaFIX, Lexitas lockbox processing, Amneal SLA error detection).
hype_vs_reality.reality: Enterprise integration requires strict determinism, ACID transactions, data governance, and human-in-the-loop validation; LLMs alone hallucinate without grounded context.
hype_vs_reality.where_not_to_use: High-throughput financial ledger updates or regulatory filings without human verification gates and deterministic API boundaries.
hype_vs_reality.claim: AI agents can replace all integration logic, automatically build end-to-end pipelines, and run zero-touch enterprise operations.
hype_vs_reality.trend: Autonomous Agentic AI in Enterprise Workflows

body.full_content:
# TGH Boomi + AI Weekly Learning Program: Research, 24-Week Curriculum, and a Ready-to-Use Scheduled-Task Prompt

The best setup is one weekly digest, sent every Monday at 9:30 AM IST, built on a fixed 24-week curriculum that goes from Level 0 to architect. It should be delivered through a Google Workspace Studio flow, or through an Apps Script + Gemini API job if TGH's Google Workspace edition doesn't include Studio.

## Curriculum Overview (24 Weeks)
- Phase 1: Foundations (Weeks 1–5) - Git, APIs/REST/JSON, LLM fundamentals, Prompt Engineering, Boomi Basics
- Phase 2: Boomi AI & Agent Protocols (Weeks 6–14) - Built-in agents, Agentstudio, MCP, Boomi Connect & AI Gateway, A2A, RAG & Hubs, Agent Integrations, Orchestrate & Companion, Gotchas
- Phase 3: Governance, Business & Industry (Weeks 15–20) - Agent Control Tower, Security & DPDP, Observability & Eval, Case Studies & ROI, Competitor Landscape, Client Discovery
- Phase 4: Architect Level (Weeks 21–24) - Multi-Agent Patterns, Scale & Cost, Event-Driven Agentic Architecture, Capstone (InstaFIX 2.0)

## Scheduled-Task Prompt & Operational Architecture
- Cadence: Every Monday 9:00 AM IST (generated) / 9:30 AM IST (delivered)
- Target Audience: TGH junior/associate engineers and integration developers
- Primary Flow: Workspace Studio / Apps Script + Gemini API Grounding + MS Teams / Google Chat / Email

topics: Week 1: Git & Git Bash from zero
Week 2: APIs, REST, JSON and XML
Week 4: Prompt engineering for integration engineers
Week 9: Boomi Connect, AI Gateway and MCP Registry
Week 11: RAG, vector databases, Knowledge Hub and Meta Hub
phases.phase: Phase 2: Boomi AI and agent protocols (Weeks 6–14)

topics: Week 15: Agent Control Tower and governance
Week 16: AI security, DPDP and data sovereignty
Week 17: Observability and evaluation of agents
Week 18: Business week, case studies and ROI
Week 20: How to talk to clients about AI
